invalid_if: The term sheet has no lapse date
name: Expiry
title: Expiry
text:
This provision is a Binding Provision.
(a) This Term Sheet takes effect on {{ts_effective_date_text}}. It lapses on {{ts_expiry_text}} if the Definitive Agreements have not been executed by then, or earlier on the date on which the Investor notifies the Company in writing that it does not wish to proceed.
(b) When this Term Sheet lapses, its non-binding provisions cease to have any effect, the Exclusivity Period ends, and the obligations of confidentiality continue for {{ts_confidentiality_survival_text}} after the date of lapse.
(c) Lapse does not affect any right or liability under a Binding Provision that arose before the date of lapse.

legal_basis.note: Certainty: the binding provisions need a definite end

authoring_note: A term sheet without an end date leaves the exclusivity and confidentiality obligations open. Both dates come from the user.
d4_44: Rebuilt 9 Oct 2026. Non-binding provisions are drafted as proposals ('it is proposed that ... be'), never as obligations, so the wording agrees with the Status provision.
